summary: Intellia Therapeutics filed an 8-K for a senior secured credit facility of up to $400 million with OrbiMed as administrative agent and initial lender. The initial $75 million tranche was drawn on September 4, 2026, with additional tranches contingent on FDA approval and revenue milestones. This is a standard corporate financing arrangement used for working capital and general purposes, not a special situation such as a capital return, restructuring, or strategic review. Notes carry SOFR plus 6.15% margin.
